name: coolify
description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 360+ one-click services on your own servers.
one_liner: A free, self-hosted alternative to Heroku and Vercel — deploy and manage apps, databases, and services on your own server instead of renting someone else's cloud.
buyer: A freelance developer or small agency serving budget-conscious small-business clients who want reliable app hosting without ongoing per-seat cloud platform fees.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer deploys and manages client apps on a single VPS using Coolify, charging a monthly 'hosting management' fee instead of clients paying Heroku/Vercel bills directly.
A small agency standardizes all client deployments on self-hosted Coolify to cut recurring cloud platform costs and increase their own margin.
A technical consultant migrates a startup off an expensive PaaS onto their own servers via Coolify as a one-time cost-cutting project.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'managed self-hosted deployment' service: set up and maintain Coolify on a client's own server for a recurring fee undercutting Heroku/Vercel pricing.
Run a one-time migration service moving small businesses off expensive PaaS platforms onto self-hosted Coolify.

steal_this: Migrate one of your own side projects off a paid PaaS onto a cheap VPS running Coolify this weekend, then offer the same migration as a paid service to a client still paying Heroku/Vercel bills.
